description: This Java class 'CustomerDAO' provides data access methods for Customer entities, including save, findById, findAll, update, and delete operations, interacting with a SQL database.

classes.name: CustomerDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for Customer entity, handling database CRUD operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts a new Customer into the database and sets its generated ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by its ID from the database.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Customers ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Customer record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Customer record by ID.

methods.name: mapRowToCustomer
methods.description: Maps a ResultSet row to a Customer object.
